capabilities.label: AI chat assistant
howTo: Start with your goal and the audience in one or two sentences.
Paste any source material and ask for a first draft or answer.
Iterate: ask it to shorten, change tone, or explain its reasoning.
capabilities.samplePrompt: You are an expert [role]. Help me [task] for [audience]. Ask me 3 clarifying questions first.

capabilities.label: Writing & rewriting
howTo: Give the format, length and tone you want.
Generate two or three variants and pick the strongest.
Edit the result in your own voice before publishing.
capabilities.samplePrompt: Write a [format] about [topic] for [audience]. Tone: [tone]. Length: [words]. Include a strong opening line.

capabilities.label: Summarizing
howTo: Upload or paste the document, video link or article.
Ask for key points, decisions and open questions.
Request a version tailored to your role or next action.
capabilities.samplePrompt: Summarize this in 5 bullet points, then list 3 action items for a [role].

capabilities.label: Translation & localization
howTo: Set source and target language plus the region.
Provide a glossary of terms that must not change.
Have a native speaker spot-check important text.
capabilities.samplePrompt: Translate to [language] for readers in [region]. Keep these terms unchanged: [terms].

capabilities.label: Prompt helpers
howTo: Describe the outcome you want in plain words.
Let the tool expand it into a structured prompt.
Test the prompt in your favorite assistant and refine.
capabilities.samplePrompt: Turn this rough idea into a detailed prompt with role, context, constraints and output format: [idea]

capabilities.label: Image generation
howTo: Describe subject, style, lighting and composition.
Generate several variations and upscale the best.
Check the license before commercial use.
capabilities.samplePrompt: [subject], [style] style, [lighting], [camera angle], high detail, [aspect ratio]

capabilities.label: Photo editing
howTo: Upload a high-resolution original.
Apply one change at a time (background, lighting, upscale).
Export in the format your platform needs.
capabilities.samplePrompt: Remove the background, brighten the subject slightly and export as a transparent PNG.

capabilities.label: Graphic & UI design
howTo: Pick a template or describe the layout you need.
Set your brand colors and fonts once.
Generate variations, then fine-tune spacing by hand.
capabilities.samplePrompt: Design a [format, e.g. Instagram post] for [message] using [brand colors], minimal and bold.

capabilities.label: Logos & branding
howTo: Describe your business, audience and personality in a few words.
Shortlist three concepts and test them small and large.
Export a full brand kit (logo, colors, fonts).
capabilities.samplePrompt: A simple, modern logo for [business] that feels [adjectives]. Flat, works in one color.

capabilities.label: Interior design
howTo: Upload a well-lit photo of the room.
Choose a style and budget level.
Save versions you like and compare side by side.
capabilities.samplePrompt: Redesign this living room in [style] style with a [budget] budget, keep the window placement.

capabilities.label: Video generation
howTo: Write a short script or shot list first.
Generate clips scene by scene rather than all at once.
Assemble, add music and captions in an editor.
capabilities.samplePrompt: A 5-second shot of [subject] [action], [camera movement], [style], [lighting].

capabilities.label: Video editing & clips
howTo: Upload your long-form recording.
Let the tool cut highlights and add captions.
Review every cut and adjust the hook in the first 3 seconds.
capabilities.samplePrompt: Find the 3 most engaging 30-second moments and add bold captions.

capabilities.label: AI avatars & presenters
howTo: Write a script of 60–90 seconds.
Pick an avatar and voice that fit your audience.
Add slides or b-roll so it does not feel static.
capabilities.samplePrompt: Script: a friendly 60-second explainer about [topic] for [audience], ending with [call to action].

capabilities.label: Screen recording & tutorials
howTo: Plan the steps you will demo.
Record once; let AI remove filler and add zooms.
Export with captions and chapter markers.
capabilities.samplePrompt: Turn this recording into a step-by-step guide with screenshots and short captions.

capabilities.label: Voiceover & text-to-speech
howTo: Write for the ear: short sentences, clear pauses.
Pick a voice and test pronunciation of names.
Only clone voices you have permission to use.
capabilities.samplePrompt: Read this in a warm, conversational tone at a moderate pace: [script]

capabilities.label: Music generation
howTo: Describe genre, mood, tempo and instruments.
Generate several takes and extend the best one.
Check usage rights for your platform.
capabilities.samplePrompt: Upbeat lo-fi track, 90 BPM, warm piano and soft drums, no vocals, 2 minutes.

capabilities.label: Transcription & captions
howTo: Upload clean audio or video.
Set the language and speaker names.
Proofread names and numbers before sharing.
capabilities.samplePrompt: Transcribe with speaker labels and timestamps every 30 seconds.

capabilities.label: Podcasting
howTo: Outline the episode and questions.
Record, then let AI clean noise and filler words.
Generate show notes, chapters and social clips.
capabilities.samplePrompt: Write show notes with a summary, 5 key takeaways and chapter timestamps.

capabilities.label: Coding assistant
howTo: Open your project so the assistant sees context.
Ask for small, testable changes.
Review and run tests before committing.
capabilities.samplePrompt: Explain this function, then refactor it for readability and add unit tests.

capabilities.label: App & website builders
howTo: Describe the app: users, screens and data.
Generate a first version and click through it.
Iterate one screen at a time, then connect real data.
capabilities.samplePrompt: Build a [type] app where [users] can [main action]. Pages: [list]. Style: clean and modern.

capabilities.label: Developer tools & APIs
howTo: Read the quickstart and pricing limits.
Keep API keys on a server, never in browser code.
Add rate limits and monitoring before launch.
capabilities.samplePrompt: Show a minimal server-side example that calls this API and handles errors and retries.

capabilities.label: Meeting notes
howTo: Connect your calendar and tell participants you are recording.
Review the summary and action items after the call.
Push tasks to your project tool.
capabilities.samplePrompt: Summarize decisions, owners and deadlines from this meeting.

capabilities.label: Email
howTo: Let the tool triage and label your inbox.
Draft replies from short bullet points.
Always read before sending.
capabilities.samplePrompt: Reply politely declining, suggest next Tuesday instead, keep it under 80 words.

capabilities.label: Scheduling & calendar
howTo: Connect your calendars and set working hours.
Add tasks with priorities and deadlines.
Let the tool auto-plan, then lock important blocks.
capabilities.samplePrompt: Plan my week around these tasks and protect two 90-minute focus blocks per day.

capabilities.label: Notes, docs & knowledge
howTo: Import existing notes and documents.
Ask questions across everything you saved.
Turn answers into reusable pages or templates.
capabilities.samplePrompt: From my notes, list everything I know about [topic] and what is still missing.

capabilities.label: Presentations
howTo: Give the topic, audience and number of slides.
Generate an outline first, then slides.
Replace generic images and check every number.
capabilities.samplePrompt: Create a 10-slide deck on [topic] for [audience] with one key message per slide.

capabilities.label: Forms & surveys
howTo: Describe what you want to learn and from whom.
Generate questions and remove leading ones.
Use AI to summarize the responses.
capabilities.samplePrompt: Create a 6-question survey to learn why customers [behavior]. Mix rating and open questions.

capabilities.label: Diagrams & whiteboards
howTo: Describe the process or system in plain text.
Generate a diagram and fix the layout.
Export or embed it in your docs.
capabilities.samplePrompt: Draw a flowchart for [process] with decision points and owners.

capabilities.label: AI browsers
howTo: Install and sign in to sync bookmarks.
Use the side panel to summarize or compare pages.
Review permissions it asks for.
capabilities.samplePrompt: Compare the pricing on these three open tabs in a table.

capabilities.label: Research & answer engines
howTo: Ask a specific question, not a keyword.
Open the cited sources and verify key claims.
Follow up to go deeper on one angle.
capabilities.samplePrompt: What does current research say about [question]? Cite sources and note disagreements.

capabilities.label: Scientific research
howTo: Start from a precise research question.
Find and screen papers, then read the key ones yourself.
Extract methods and results into a table.
capabilities.samplePrompt: Find peer-reviewed papers on [topic] since [year] and summarize methods and findings in a table.

capabilities.label: Marketing & SEO
howTo: Define audience, offer and channel.
Generate angles and test the best two.
Measure, keep winners and iterate weekly.
capabilities.samplePrompt: Give me 10 ad headlines for [product] targeting [audience], each under 40 characters.

capabilities.label: Social media
howTo: Pick one platform and a posting rhythm.
Batch-create a week of posts from one idea.
Schedule and review analytics every week.
capabilities.samplePrompt: Turn this idea into 5 LinkedIn posts with hooks, and 3 short-video scripts: [idea]

capabilities.label: Sales & CRM
howTo: Define your ideal customer profile.
Research and personalize outreach at scale.
Log every touch in your CRM automatically.
capabilities.samplePrompt: Write a 4-step outreach sequence for [persona] about [problem], under 90 words each.

capabilities.label: E-commerce
howTo: Generate product descriptions and photos in your brand style.
Add AI search or recommendations to your store.
Track conversion before and after.
capabilities.samplePrompt: Write a product description for [product] highlighting [benefits], 120 words, SEO keyword [keyword].

capabilities.label: Customer support & chatbots
howTo: Feed it your FAQs and help articles.
Start with AI-suggested replies reviewed by humans.
Automate only the questions it answers reliably.
capabilities.samplePrompt: Answer customer questions using only our help center. If unsure, hand off to a human.

capabilities.label: Data analysis
howTo: Upload a clean CSV or connect your sheet.
Ask questions in plain language.
Check the formulas or code it used.
capabilities.samplePrompt: Find the top 3 trends in this data and chart monthly growth. Explain any anomalies.

capabilities.label: Workflow automation
howTo: Write down the manual steps you repeat.
Automate one step at a time with a trigger and action.
Add alerts so you know when something fails.
capabilities.samplePrompt: When a new [form response] arrives, summarize it, add it to [sheet] and notify me in [chat].

capabilities.label: AI agents
howTo: Give the agent a clear goal and limits.
Start with read-only access and review its plan.
Expand permissions only after it proves reliable.
capabilities.samplePrompt: Research [topic], draft a one-page brief with sources, and stop before sending anything.

capabilities.label: Learning & tutoring
howTo: Tell it your level and goal.
Ask it to quiz you instead of just explaining.
Turn weak areas into flashcards.
capabilities.samplePrompt: Teach me [topic] at a [level] level, then quiz me with 5 questions and explain mistakes.

capabilities.label: Finance & accounting
howTo: Connect accounts read-only where possible.
Use AI to categorize and spot trends.
Verify anything that affects taxes with a professional.
capabilities.samplePrompt: Categorize these expenses and show where I can save 10% next month.

capabilities.label: Legal & compliance
howTo: Upload the document and state your role (buyer, seller, employee).
Ask for risky clauses in plain language.
Have a qualified lawyer review before signing.
capabilities.samplePrompt: List the 5 riskiest clauses in this contract for the [party] and explain each simply.

capabilities.label: Health & fitness
howTo: Share your goal and constraints (time, equipment, diet).
Follow a plan for two weeks and log progress.
Consult a professional for medical decisions.
capabilities.samplePrompt: Create a 4-week beginner workout plan, 3 days a week, 30 minutes, no equipment.

capabilities.label: Travel planning
howTo: Give dates, budget and travel style.
Generate an itinerary and check opening hours.
Book directly with providers you trust.
capabilities.samplePrompt: Plan 4 days in [city] for [interests] on a [budget] budget, walking-friendly.

capabilities.label: Fashion & styling
howTo: Upload photos of items you own.
Ask for outfits by occasion and weather.
Save looks and note what you actually wear.
capabilities.samplePrompt: Suggest 5 outfits for [occasion] using these items, for [weather].

capabilities.label: Gaming & 3D
howTo: Start from a reference image or sketch.
Generate the base asset, then refine in a 3D tool.
Check polygon count and license for your engine.
capabilities.samplePrompt: A low-poly [object] game asset, stylized, clean topology, PBR textures.

capabilities.label: HR & recruiting
howTo: Write a clear role scorecard first.
Use AI to draft job posts and screen consistently.
Keep humans in final decisions and audit for bias.
capabilities.samplePrompt: Write an inclusive job post for a [role] with 5 must-haves and 3 nice-to-haves.

capabilities.label: Cybersecurity
howTo: Define what you are protecting and from whom.
Use AI to triage alerts and explain findings.
Verify fixes and keep an audit trail.
capabilities.samplePrompt: Explain this alert in plain language, its severity and the first 3 steps to respond.

capabilities.label: Real estate
howTo: Generate listing copy and virtual staging.
Analyze comparable properties.
Disclose AI-edited images to buyers.
capabilities.samplePrompt: Write a listing for a [beds]-bed [type] in [area], highlighting [features], 150 words.

capabilities.label: Operations & industry
howTo: Pick one measurable bottleneck.
Pilot the tool on a small slice of operations.
Compare results against your baseline.
capabilities.samplePrompt: Analyze this demand data and suggest reorder points for the top 10 items.

capabilities.label: Responsible AI
howTo: List where AI touches decisions in your workflow.
Test outputs for bias and errors.
Document policies and review them regularly.
capabilities.samplePrompt: Review this AI use case for risks, bias and privacy issues, and suggest safeguards.

goals.label: Build software & products
goals.description: Code faster, ship apps and automate with agents.

goals.label: Pursue a hobby or passion
goals.description: Music, art, travel, fitness, games and more.
